#Hobo.Face.smile
You: I lost…
Hobo: Hahaha! In the end you couldn’t even beat me! {{wi}}ME of all people! How embarrassing is that?!
You: I just want this nightmare to end! 
Hobo: Yeah, run away like a coward! But remember! I will hunt you forever! In the end, all your doubts will consume you, and you will end up like me! On the streets! Hahahaha!
